text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each contrast in each lead band. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re- drawing whole weeks of forecast start. Line at 0: same score. Exploratory. Quantile score in points of capacity (1 point is 1% of a substation's capacity).'
